title: Built-in voice input, agent applets, and a pinned session status line
highlights: Built-in voice input for the CLI, with native microphone capture on macOS and Windows and coding-aware dictation vocabulary
The session status line (directory, branch, git status, context, provider, and model) stays pinned below the input, with info widgets showing the detail behind it
Agents can show interactive applets, and swarms can message each other across swarms with unique labels
improvements: The Changes widget lists dirty files newest first with line counts and marks the files the agent edited
MCP tools load through provider-native deferred loading, so adding or using MCP servers no longer busts the prompt cache
Accounts have a persistent auto-switch pool, and failover rotates through it in your chosen order
Show an upgrade card and daily feature allowances when a Jcode plan limit is reached
The daemon detects KV cache misses and reports them to every client
Untitled sessions are named after their first prompt, and save labels name the session
Keep your reading position across terminal resizes
Support embedded and multiple slash commands in one message
The first Ctrl+C clears the input and the second quits
Add the Yolo-Auto provider, grok-4.7 and grok-4.6 on Cursor, and OpenRouter image support from the model catalog
Block lid-close sleep on macOS and Windows while sessions are working
Rust and TypeScript SDKs support per-connection SSH identities and pinned host keys
fixes: Antigravity consumer accounts no longer hit 429s from the wrong endpoint
Claude usage limits are shared across processes and keep the last good values when throttled
MCP servers no longer stall startup or spawn duplicates, and pending requests fail when a stdio server exits
Reload exits with an error when the new server never becomes ready
Switching models validates against the target provider, and configured default models with a provider prefix match correctly
The effort chip follows model changes, and the alternate-enter hint respects queue mode and keymap conflicts
Ctrl+Up into prompt history keeps your draft
Hooks never flash a console window on Windows
DeepSeek Flash and MiMo v2.6 models keep their full context window
